title: Contract
description:
Schema generation root. Rust wire types are the contract source of truth.
@see docs/architecture.md

client_id.description: Public application identifier, never the secret key or an access token.

Action.description:
One command entry point; relative edits are applied to current authoritative state.
@see docs/architecture.md

ActionDescriptor.description:
Enumerated commands are discoverable alongside numeric parameters.
@see docs/architecture.md

oneOf.description: IR models have no NAM architecture; omit the provider filter.

key.description: Hash of the metadata URL; URLs (potentially signed) never reach the browser or logs.

oneOf.description: Restart the same tone with new device settings, retaining confirmed scalar edits.

streaming_available.description: Discovery support must never be mistaken for an implemented playback engine.

id.description: ALSA card ID plus PCM device; re-enumerate before using it. Not a USB serial number.

streaming_available.description: Only a point-in-time open/configure/readback/close check, never live readiness.

boot_error.description: Shared boot policy failure; clearing it never requires a working audio device.

controls.description: Confirmed controls of the sounding worker; cleared whenever it stops.

device_owned.description: Remains true until the worker is reaped, including failed shutdowns.

modified.description: Session edits are not written back to the immutable starting preset.

saved_copy.description: Last copy saved from this exact control revision; restart still uses configured.

start_on_boot.description: Explicitly opt in to restoring the captured confirmed session after daemon startup.

working.description: Immutable local working-state receipt; never a file path or portable preset.

program.description: Exactly one trigger is required. Programs are wire values 0–127.

BlockControl.description: Native block readback, with a server-issued edit target. Values are normalized 0–1.

BlockEqState.description: Exact per-block EQ readback, retained independently of scalar controls.

oneOf.description: An intact native preset, not an extracted NAM or cabinet stage.

Capabilities.description:
Development appliance capabilities; audio is deliberately unavailable.
@see docs/architecture.md

ChainBlock.description: Exact native lane order, including insertion tiles. No provider credentials or model paths.

clips.description: Samples at or above full scale, cumulative for this worker lifetime.

EqEdit.description: One immediate, revision-owned edit; UI cancellation sends its original value.

GraphRecall.description: Durable scalar/MIDI values, independent of transient command sessions and edit leases.

Inspection.description: Structural inspection only. Original bytes, not this summary, remain authoritative.

LiveControl.description: Native playback controls use normalized values; display text comes from the DSP.

MidiCurve.description:
Scaling policy for a mapped absolute knob.
@see docs/architecture.md

MidiMapping.description:
Versioned MIDI mapping. Feedback uses a separate output route, never an input route.
@see docs/architecture.md

ModelAssignment.description:
Immutable verified asset assigned to a native block. Insert position is issued
by the playback owner, preserving replay order from the immutable working base.

request.description: Start-command serial within the audio session; rejects cancellation of a newer selection.

xruns.description: Transport currently fails closed on xruns; a cumulative recovery counter is not available.

parameters.description: Normalized native parameter values, limited to the reference machine defaults.

Node.description:
Stable block identity and a declared PoC block kind.
@see docs/architecture.md

NodeEq.description: EQ belongs to a native graph node and its stable inner block identities.

source_sha256.description: Original import lineage; None means authored from an empty native rig.

Parameter.description:
Discoverable controls share stable IDs across MIDI and web adapters.
@see docs/architecture.md

writable.description: Adapter qualification, separate from the native automation flag.

PluginCatalog.description:
Fresh installed metadata, checked against the same admission rules as the host.
This is not an instantiation, state-restoration or real-time guarantee.

PortableNativePartition.description:
Reproducible guarded derivation from the exact source preset, never imported
opaque JUCE bytes. Both roles share a pair/recipe; scalar overrides are local.

Rig.description:
Persisted routing data, independent of UI layout and audio resources.
@see docs/architecture.md

recovery_error.description: Checkpoint failure is separate from playback state and command authority.

manifest_json.description: Exact manifest JSON: strict parsing also rejects duplicate keys in metadata.

resources.description: Each declared resource maps to an existing verified local payload.

Settings2.description: Device-local configuration, deliberately absent from portable sound data.

Snapshot.description:
Every subscriber receives a complete, revisioned snapshot; dropped intermediates resync safely.
@see docs/architecture.md

latency_frames.description: Reported algorithmic and alignment delay; excludes audio devices/transport.

modified.description: Actual scalar values differ from the immutable source bundle.

draft.description: An immutable working base created locally, separate from imported/saved libraries.

preset_id.description: Immutable imported/owned preset identity, never a browser-supplied file path.

working.description: Verified local authoring checkpoint tied to this immutable preset.

name.description: Working name belongs to the audible session, not an individual browser view.

prepared.description: Resident alternatives are prepared before this transport opens PCM.

input_map.description: Zero-based channels; duplicate input indexes copy mono to both processor channels.

output_map.description: Duplicate output indexes mix the stereo processor output equally into mono.
